subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these fourteen external Action revisions, including the Codex Action revision that receives an OpenAI API key, after exact-head workflow evidence is available?
rationale: The patch is mechanically simple and keeps the current Codex sandbox input, but acceptance of upgraded third-party executable code on credential-bearing automation is a repository security-boundary decision.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Review the pinned upstream revisions and approve only after redacted successful runs cover the sensitive Codex, GitHub App token, and release/security workflows.

options.title: Split sensitive revisions
options.body: Keep routine setup and labeling updates separate while a dedicated security review evaluates the credential-bearing Action upgrades.

options.title: Pause this grouped update
options.body: Close or defer the batch if the repository prefers to advance sensitive workflow actions individually with owner review.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Review the pinned upstream revisions and approve only after redacted successful runs cover the sensitive Codex, GitHub App token, and release/security workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the closest identifiable current workflow-surface routing candidate, although broader workflow ownership is shared.
